source.prompt: best budget tkl mechanical keyboard for gaming in india

answer.text:
For gamers in India seeking budget-friendly TKL mechanical or semi-mechanical keyboards, options like the EvoFox Fireblade TKL, EvoFox Katana X2 TKL, and Ant Esports MK700 V2 offer reliable performance, RGB lighting, and anti-ghosting features at affordable prices.
Top Recommendations
EvoFox Fireblade TKL Semi-Mechanical Keyboard
Features: Semi-mechanical keys with tactile feedback, rainbow backlighting, 19 anti-ghosting keys, 12 multimedia keys, Windows lock key, braided cable.
Pros: Compact TKL layout saves desk space, durable build, suitable for both gaming and typing 1.
Price Range: Budget-friendly under ₹2,000.
EvoFox Katana X2 TKL Mechanical Keyboard
Features: Mechanical clicky Blue switches, dynamic RGB backlighting, all keys anti-ghosting, volume knob, dedicated gaming functions (Copilot, Xbox Gamebar).
Pros: Fully mechanical feel, reliable switch performance, ideal for gaming enthusiasts on a budget 1.
Ant Esports MK700 V2 Membrane TKL Gaming Keyboard
Features: Membrane keyboard with mechanical feel keys, 87 UV-coated keys, RGB backlight, waterproof design.
Pros: Affordable alternative for those preferring a mechanical feel without the higher cost of full mechanical switches 1.
Cosmic Byte CB-GK-20 Styx TKL Membrane Gaming Keyboard
Features: TKL layout with rainbow LED backlighting, designed for ergonomic gaming use.
Pros: Lightweight and compact, budget-friendly, straightforward setup 1.
2 Sources
Buying Tips for Budget TKL Keyboards in India
Switch Type: Blue switches provide tactile clicky feedback; red switches are linear and quieter. Semi-mechanical keyboards mimic switch feel at a lower cost.
Anti-Ghosting: Look for keyboards with 19+ anti-ghosting keys for smooth combination key presses in games.
Build Quality: Braided cables and solid keycaps improve durability.
RGB Lighting: Optional but enhances aesthetics; check if lighting modes are customizable.
Budget Consideration: TKL mechanical keyboards under ₹2,000–₹3,000 offer good performance without overspending.
Overall, EvoFox Fireblade TKL and EvoFox Katana X2 TKL remain the most popular budget TKL options in India due to their mechanical/ semi-mechanical switches, compact design, and gamer-focused features +1. For a tight budget, the Ant Esports MK700 V2 provides a satisfactory gaming experience with membrane keys.
